s.note: Corned beef hash and a fried egg, in a tin.
s.how: Dice 400g potatoes and boil 6 minutes, then drain. Fry 1 diced brown onion in 30g butter, add the potato and 340g corned beef broken up, press flat and fry without stirring until crusty, then turn and repeat. Fry 4 eggs. Serve the hash in clean empty tins with an egg on top.

s.note: Frankfurts coiled in puff pastry, two dips
s.how: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a large tray. Cut each pastry sheet into 3 strips. Lay the frankfurts end to end along the strips, roll the pastry around them and pinch the joins so they make one long roll. Coil the roll on the tray like a snake. Shape a head at one end and press in the peppercorns for eyes. Brush with egg, scatter with sesame seeds and bake for 25 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve on a board with the barbecue sauce and mustard to dip.

m.how: Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with 4 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tbsp chopped rosemary, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tsp salt. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Serve with 8 warm flatbreads, 250g Greek yoghurt and a salad of 4 chopped tomatoes with red onion.

w.note: Soft dumplings simmered in golden syrup sauce, served with cream
w.how: Rub 40g butter into 250g self-raising flour, mix in 150ml milk to a soft dough and roll into 12 balls. Bring 250ml water, 100g golden syrup, 100g brown sugar and 40g butter to a simmer in a wide pan. Drop in the dumplings, cover and cook 20 minutes without lifting the lid. Serve with 200ml cream.

w.note: Boomerang biscuits dipped in dark chocolate
w.how: Beat 200g soft butter with 100g icing sugar, then mix in 300g plain flour to a dough. Roll 5mm thick, cut into boomerang shapes and bake at 160C for 15 minutes until pale gold. Cool and dip the tips in 100g melted dark chocolate.

d.note: Dark rum floated over ginger beer and lime
d.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each and add 150ml cold ginger beer. Pour 45ml dark rum slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats dark on top. Add a lime wedge and serve unstirred. Totals are 180ml dark rum, 600ml ginger beer and 2 limes. Skip the rum for a plain ginger beer and lime.
